name: Platform Foundation Buyers (SaaS Foundation + Custom Build)

pain_points: Building from scratch is slow and expensive
Need scalable foundation without full custom build

fit_logic.proceed: They accept a productised core + defined extension scope and timeline
fit_logic.park: They want 'anything built' with no constraints or roadmap discipline
fit_logic.stop: Unlimited custom dev expectations without boundaries

what_they_sell: Their own product or programme. Yoke is the foundation layer.
what_proof_means: Built-in measurement and alerting that proves performance and guides iteration. Reliability and governability of the core platform.
yoke_strengths: Foundation you can build on + proof/insight loop + speed/reuse
yoke_weaknesses: Unlimited custom dev without boundaries (turns into agency work and margin leak)

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke provides a proven platform foundation with built-in measurement—letting you build custom features on top without starting from scratch.
key_benefits: Start with proven core instead of building from scratch
Define extension scope and integrate with your stack
messaging.elevator_pitch: Building a platform from scratch is slow and expensive. Yoke gives you a proven foundation with measurement built in—so you can add custom features without the build drag.

unknowns: Their stack requirements, security posture, integration priorities

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase product capability without build time
two_lever_framing.lever_b: Reduce platform development costs and integration drag
